title: Chula Tacos
summary: Designed and prepared permit drawings for the tenant improvement of a 2,254-square-foot commercial space into a full-service Mexican restaurant. The project included ADA accessibility, commercial kitchen planning, life safety coordination, and construction documentation for permitting
projectDetails: Conversion of a newly constructed commercial shell into a full-service Mexican restaurant
Commercial kitchen and food preparation design
Type I kitchen exhaust hood and fire suppression coordination
Walk-in refrigerator and commercial freezer planning
ADA-compliant entrance, restrooms, dining, and service counters
Commercial kitchen equipment and utility coordination
Mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC coordination
Occupancy change from Group B to Assembly A-2
City of San Diego permitting and Health Department coordination
highlights: Complete restaurant build-out from an unoccupied shell space
Integrated Type I hood and fire suppression systems
Coordinated architectural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing disciplines
Efficient customer circulation and restaurant workflow
Permit-ready construction documents for restaurant operations
